q_po_grouped_school_breakdown_from_po:
-- Other schools and cooking memberships stay unchanged.
-- q_po_grouped_school_breakdown_from_po
-- Export-only school labels; only Hùng Vương meals share a PO entity.
WITH school_labels AS (
  SELECT s.*,
    CASE WHEN s.id IN (47,48,49,50,53) THEN 47 ELSE s.id END AS export_school_id,
    CASE WHEN s.id = 8 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN s.id = 9 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' WHEN s.id IN (47,48,49,50,53) THEN regexp_replace(regexp_replace(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(hv.school_full_name),''),hv.name)), '^TRƯỜNG[[:space:]]+', '', 'i'), '[[:space:]]*[(][^)]*[)]$', '', 'i') ELSE regexp_replace(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(s.school_full_name),''),s.name)), '^TRƯỜNG[[:space:]]+', '', 'i') END AS export_school_name,
    CASE WHEN s.id IN (47,48,49,50,53) THEN hv.display_order ELSE s.display_order END AS export_display_order
  FROM public.schools s
  LEFT JOIN public.schools hv ON hv.id = 47
),
active_groups AS (
  SELECT
    g.id,
    g.name
  FROM public.po_export_groups g
  WHERE g.is_active = true
),
member_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.school_id,
    m.group_id
  FROM public.po_export_group_members m
),
group_map AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS school_id,
    'school'::text AS entity_type,
    'S:' || s.export_school_id::text AS entity_key,
    s.export_school_id AS entity_numeric_id,
    s.export_school_id AS entity_id_legacy,
    s.export_school_name || CASE
      WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL
       AND lower(btrim(s.name)) IS DISTINCT FROM lower(btrim(g.name))
      THEN ' (Nấu tại: ' || g.name || ')'
      ELSE ''
    END AS entity_name,
    COALESCE(s.export_display_order, 999999) AS entity_display_order
  FROM school_labels s
  LEFT JOIN member_map mm ON mm.school_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN active_groups g ON g.id = mm.group_id
)
SELECT
  po.supplier_id,
  sup.name AS supplier_name,
  pol.service_date,

  gm.entity_type,
  gm.entity_key,
  gm.entity_numeric_id,
  gm.entity_id_legacy,
  gm.entity_name,
  gm.entity_display_order,

  pol.ingredient_id,
  i.name AS ingredient_name,
  pol.purchase_unit,
  COALESCE(pol.note, '') AS note,

  SUM(COALESCE(pol.qty, 0))::numeric AS qty
FROM public.purchase_order_lines pol
JOIN public.purchase_orders po
  ON po.id = pol.po_id
JOIN public.suppliers sup
  ON sup.id = po.supplier_id
JOIN public.ingredients i
  ON i.id = pol.ingredient_id
JOIN group_map gm
  ON gm.school_id = pol.school_id
WHERE pol.service_date BETWEEN {{ PO_datepicker.value.start }}::date
                           AND {{ PO_datepicker.value.end }}::date
GROUP BY
  po.supplier_id,
  sup.name,
  pol.service_date,
  gm.entity_type,
  gm.entity_key,
  gm.entity_numeric_id,
  gm.entity_id_legacy,
  gm.entity_name,
  gm.entity_display_order,
  pol.ingredient_id,
  i.name,
  pol.purchase_unit,
  COALESCE(pol.note, '')
ORDER BY
  pol.service_date,
  sup.name,
  gm.entity_display_order,
  gm.entity_name,
  i.name,
  pol.purchase_unit,
  COALESCE(pol.note, '');

q_dispatch_lines_grouped:
WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    {{ PO_datepicker.value.start }}::date AS d1,
    {{ PO_datepicker.value.end }}::date   AS d2,

    CASE
      WHEN {{ JSON.stringify(selSchoolMulti.value || []) }}::jsonb = '[]'::jsonb
        THEN NULL::bigint[]
      ELSE (
        SELECT array_agg(
          CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(e) = 'object'
              THEN NULLIF(
                COALESCE(
                  e->>'value',
                  e->>'id'
                ),
                ''
              )::bigint
            ELSE
              trim(
                both '"'
                from e::text
              )::bigint
          END
        )
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(
          {{ JSON.stringify(selSchoolMulti.value || []) }}::jsonb
        ) AS x(e)
      )
    END AS school_ids
),


-- =========================================================
-- MAP EACH SCHOOL TO ITS EXPORT ENTITY
-- =========================================================
group_map AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS school_id,

    -- Member ordering inside a grouped entity.
    -- Used to determine which school supplies the displayed
    -- representative Dispatch header_id.
    s.display_order AS member_display_order,

    CASE
      WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.is_active = TRUE
        THEN 'group'
      ELSE 'school'
    END AS entity_type,

    CASE
      WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.is_active = TRUE
        THEN 'G:' || g.id::text
      ELSE 'S:' || s.id::text
    END AS entity_key,

    CASE
      WHEN g.id IS NOT NULL
       AND g.is_active = TRUE
        THEN g.id
      ELSE s.id
    END AS entity_numeric_id,

    COALESCE(
      g.id,
      s.id
    ) AS entity_id_legacy,

    regexp_replace(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(g.group_name_xlsx,''),g.name,CASE s.id WHEN 8 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN 9 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' ELSE NULL::text END,NULLIF(s.school_full_name,''),s.name)), '^TRƯỜNG[[:space:]]+', '', 'i') AS entity_name,

    regexp_replace(btrim(COALESCE(NULLIF(g.group_name_xlsx,''),g.name,CASE s.id WHEN 8 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN 9 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' ELSE NULL::text END,NULLIF(s.school_full_name,''),s.name)), '^TRƯỜNG[[:space:]]+', '', 'i') AS group_name_xlsx,

    COALESCE(
      g.delivery_info,
      s.delivery_info
    ) AS delivery_info,

    COALESCE(
      g.sub_delivery,
      s.delivery_info
    ) AS sub_delivery,

    COALESCE(
      g.display_order,
      s.display_order,
      999999
    ) AS entity_display_order,

    COALESCE(
      g.contract_type,
      s.contract_type
    ) AS effective_contract_type

  FROM public.schools s

  LEFT JOIN public.dispatch_export_group_members gm
    ON gm.school_id = s.id

  LEFT JOIN public.dispatch_export_groups g
    ON g.id = gm.group_id
   AND g.is_active = TRUE
),


-- Resolve selected schools to export entities. Selecting a highlighted
-- member includes the complete configured group, so Hùng Vương uses 47-50.
selected_entities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gm.entity_key
  FROM group_map gm
  CROSS JOIN args a
  WHERE a.school_ids IS NULL OR gm.school_id = ANY(a.school_ids)
),

-- =========================================================
-- RAW DISPATCH FACTS AFTER FILTERING
-- =========================================================
base AS (
  SELECT
    dh.id AS header_id,
    dh.dispatch_date,
    dh.school_id,

    gm.member_display_order,

    gm.entity_type,
    gm.entity_key,
    gm.entity_numeric_id,
    gm.entity_id_legacy,

    gm.entity_name,
    gm.group_name_xlsx,
    gm.delivery_info,
    gm.sub_delivery,
    gm.entity_display_order,

    gm.effective_contract_type AS contract_type,

    dl.ingredient_id,

    i.shopping_type_id,

    i.name AS ingredient_name,

    dl.purchase_unit,
    dl.qty,
    dl.dispatch_name,
    dl.note,

    dh.status,
    dh.created_by,
    dh.created_at

  FROM public.dispatch_headers dh

  JOIN args a
    ON TRUE

  JOIN public.dispatch_lines dl
    ON dl.header_id = dh.id

  JOIN public.ingredients i
    ON i.id = dl.ingredient_id

  JOIN group_map gm
    ON gm.school_id = dh.school_id

  WHERE
    dh.dispatch_date
      BETWEEN a.d1 AND a.d2

    AND (
      a.school_ids IS NULL
      OR gm.entity_key IN (SELECT entity_key FROM selected_entities)
    )
),


-- =========================================================
-- CHOOSE ONE REPRESENTATIVE HEADER PER DATE + EXPORT ENTITY
--
-- "First member" means the first member that actually
-- contributes to this export, ordered by:
--
--   schools.display_order
--   school_id
--   header_id
--
-- For an ungrouped school, this naturally returns its own
-- Dispatch header.
-- =========================================================
representative_headers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (
    dispatch_date,
    entity_key
  )
    dispatch_date,
    entity_key,

    header_id
      AS representative_header_id,

    school_id
      AS representative_school_id

  FROM base

  ORDER BY
    dispatch_date,
    entity_key,

    member_display_order
      NULLS LAST,

    school_id,

    header_id
),


-- =========================================================
-- AGGREGATE TO GROUPED EXPORT GRAIN
-- =========================================================
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    dispatch_date,

    dispatch_date::text
      || '|'
      || entity_key
      AS export_key,

    array_agg(
      DISTINCT header_id
      ORDER BY header_id
    ) AS header_ids,

    count(
      DISTINCT header_id
    ) AS header_count,

    entity_type,
    entity_key,
    entity_numeric_id,
    entity_id_legacy,

    entity_name,
    group_name_xlsx,

    delivery_info,
    sub_delivery,

    entity_display_order,
    contract_type,

    ingredient_id,
    shopping_type_id,
    ingredient_name,

    COALESCE(
      dispatch_name,
      ingredient_name
    ) AS dispatch_name,

    purchase_unit,

    COALESCE(
      note,
      ''
    ) AS note,

    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        qty,
        0
      )
    ) AS qty,

    CASE
      WHEN count(
        DISTINCT status
      ) = 1
        THEN min(status)

      ELSE 'MIXED'
    END AS status,

    min(
      created_at
    ) AS first_created_at,

    max(
      created_at
    ) AS last_created_at

  FROM base

  GROUP BY
    dispatch_date,

    entity_type,
    entity_key,
    entity_numeric_id,
    entity_id_legacy,

    entity_name,
    group_name_xlsx,

    delivery_info,
    sub_delivery,

    entity_display_order,
    contract_type,

    ingredient_id,
    shopping_type_id,
    ingredient_name,

    COALESCE(
      dispatch_name,
      ingredient_name
    ),

    purchase_unit,

    COALESCE(
      note,
      ''
    )
)


-- =========================================================
-- FINAL EXPORT CONTRACT
-- =========================================================
SELECT
  g.export_key,

  g.header_ids,
  g.header_count,

  -- THIS IS THE NUMBER TO PRINT ON THE GROUPED DISPATCH FORM
  rh.representative_header_id,

  -- Useful for debugging / verification.
  -- JS does not need to print this.
  rh.representative_school_id,

  g.dispatch_date,

  g.entity_type,
  g.entity_key,
  g.entity_numeric_id,
  g.entity_id_legacy,

  g.entity_name,
  g.group_name_xlsx,

  g.delivery_info,
  g.sub_delivery,

  g.entity_display_order,
  g.contract_type,

  g.ingredient_id,
  g.shopping_type_id,
  g.ingredient_name,

  g.dispatch_name,
  g.purchase_unit,
  g.note,
  g.qty,

  g.status,
  g.first_created_at,
  g.last_created_at

FROM grouped g

JOIN representative_headers rh
  ON rh.dispatch_date = g.dispatch_date
 AND rh.entity_key    = g.entity_key

ORDER BY
  g.dispatch_date,

  g.entity_display_order,

  g.entity_name,

  g.shopping_type_id
    NULLS LAST,

  g.dispatch_name,

  g.purchase_unit,

  g.note;
q_dispatch_lines:
SELECT
  dh.id                   AS header_id,
  dh.dispatch_date,
  dh.school_id,
  CASE s.id WHEN 8 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN 9 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' ELSE s.name END AS school_name,
  CASE s.id WHEN 8 THEN 'TRƯỜNG TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN 9 THEN 'TRƯỜNG TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' ELSE s.school_full_name END AS school_full_name,
  s.delivery_info,
  s.contract_type         AS contract_type,
  s.display_order         AS display_order,        -- ✅ use display_order

  dl.id                   AS line_id,
  dl.ingredient_id,
  i.shopping_type_id      AS shopping_type_id,     -- ✅ optional but recommended (for JS export)
  i.name                  AS ingredient_name,
  dl.purchase_unit,
  dl.qty,
  dl.dispatch_name,
  dl.note,

  dh.status,
  dh.created_by,
  dh.created_at
FROM public.dispatch_headers AS dh
JOIN public.schools AS s
  ON s.id = dh.school_id
JOIN public.dispatch_lines AS dl
  ON dl.header_id = dh.id
JOIN public.ingredients AS i
  ON i.id = dl.ingredient_id
WHERE dh.dispatch_date BETWEEN {{ PO_datepicker.value.start }}::date
                           AND {{ PO_datepicker.value.end   }}::date
  AND (
    json_array_length({{ JSON.stringify(selSchoolMulti.value || []) }}::json) = 0
    OR dh.school_id = ANY({{ selSchoolMulti.value }})
  )
ORDER BY
  dh.dispatch_date,
  s.display_order NULLS LAST,                      -- ✅ instead of region_code
  COALESCE(s.school_full_name, s.name),
  public.shopping_type_sort_rank(i.shopping_type_id),
  i.name;
q_po_school_breakdown_from_po:
select
  po.supplier_id,
  s.name            as supplier_name,
  pol.service_date,
  pol.school_id,
  sch.display_order as school_display_order,
  CASE sch.id WHEN 8 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - BÌNH DƯƠNG' WHEN 9 THEN 'TIỂU HỌC BÌNH MỸ - CỦ CHI' ELSE sch.name END as school_name,
  pol.ingredient_id,
  i.name            as ingredient_name,
  i.purchase_unit,
  pol.qty::numeric  as qty
from public.purchase_order_lines pol
join public.purchase_orders po on po.id = pol.po_id
join public.suppliers s        on s.id = po.supplier_id
join public.schools sch        on sch.id = pol.school_id
join public.ingredients i      on i.id = pol.ingredient_id
where po.service_date between CAST({{ PO_datepicker.value.start }} AS date)
                          and CAST({{ PO_datepicker.value.end   }} AS date)
order by
  pol.service_date,
  supplier_name,
  sch.display_order nulls last,
  sch.name,
  pol.school_id,
  ingredient_name;
